`make design-md` was not run. That generator reads catalog.json, and this capture does not edit catalog.json. Take values from [tokens.json](tokens.json). This file is a short export so the package has the DESIGN.md the layout expects.

## Overview

Fourthwall's public marketing site, captured signed out on 2026-11-21. One light theme. Ink `#0a0a0a` and paper `#ffffff` carry text and fills. The hero Start now pill is paper on ink. The declared action fill is ink with paper text, visible on the auth wall Log in button.

## Colors

Page `#ffffff` (`light.background.page`, `core.color.paper`). Surface `#f6f6f6` (`light.background.surface`). Canvas `#efeff0`. Text `#0a0a0a` (`light.text.primary`). Muted `#6d6d6f`. Soft text is ink at 60% opacity. Hairline is ink at 16% opacity. Action fill token is `#0a0a0a`.

Grey, blue, green, red and yellow ramps are in `core.color`. Twitch `#9146ff` is a partner accent. Status roles in `light.status` are Derived from those ramps and were not seen assigned on the public site. Focus outline `rgb(0, 95, 204)` is Not captured as a token.

## Typography

Body: Suisse Intl, Arial, sans-serif, 16px. Heading face: PP Telegraf. Display primitive: Saans. Nav and hero button measured 17px, weight 450. Hero heading measured 57.6px, weight 420. Fluid display clamps are not single tokens. See [README.md](README.md).

6, 8, 10, 12, 14, 18 px, plus a 999px pill. The hero button uses 12px. A 50% circle was not stored as a dimension token.
